# Mundelein Jr. Mustangs Feeder Basketball (MundyBall)

> The official feeder basketball program for Mundelein High School (MHS) in Mundelein, Illinois. Boys and girls travel teams for grades 4–8, coached by MHS staff, with a curriculum that mirrors the MHS varsity system. Website: https://www.mundyball.com

## Key facts

- Who: boys and girls in grades 4–8. No prior organized basketball experience is required.
- Affiliation: official feeder program for Mundelein High School, 1350 W Hawley St, Mundelein, IL 60060.
- Season: winter travel season, November through February, with local tournaments and league play. All games are within about 45 minutes of Mundelein High School.
- Teams: up to two teams (A and B) per grade per gender when registration supports it. Placement is by tryout evaluation, not registration order.
- Approach: two practices per game; fundamentals first (shooting, footwork, ball handling, screening, rebounding, passing, defending); every player gets meaningful first-half minutes in league play.
- Tryouts (2026–27 season): November 7 and 8, 2026 at Mundelein High School (Main Gym). Free to try out. Register by October 23, 2026 at https://www.mundyball.com/tryouts. Team placements are emailed by November 13, 2026.
- Season fee: $700 per season, invoiced only after a player makes a team (due Nov 16, 2026). Uniforms (reversible jersey, shorts, white practice t-shirt) are a separate one-time fee sold at cost, because the program doesn't want to take any extra money from families; families keep them and don't pay again if they don't need a new size next season.
- Camps: skill camps for ages 8–14 run by MHS coaches, with a 1:6 coach-to-camper ratio. $249 per week for Summer 2027. Tentative Summer 2027 weeks: June 28–July 2, July 5–9, July 12–16, July 26–30, Aug 2–6, and Aug 9–13, with a morning session (9:00–11:45 AM) and an afternoon session (12:15–3:00 PM). Families can join the Summer 2027 interest list (no payment) at https://www.mundyball.com/camps#register. Clinics, long-weekend camps, and winter break camps are also announced there.
- Financial aid: need-based aid is available confidentially. Email the program.

## Coaches

- Gio Paganis: Program Director and Head Coach; Assistant Varsity Basketball Coach at Mundelein High School; Purdue University graduate.
- Joe Scheuers: Head Varsity Boys Basketball Coach, Mundelein High School; former point guard at Trine University.
- Sarah Teipel: Head Girls Varsity Basketball Coach, Mundelein High School; MHS class of 2005; played Division I basketball at Western Illinois University.

- Email: mundeleinboysbasketball@gmail.com (Coach Paganis replies within 24 hours)
